hypothesis: A fixed progress deadline, preserved across safe plan replacements, prevents receding-horizon postponement better than ordinary MPC or a fixed executed prefix.
status: Untested candidate; novelty NOT established. Generic MPPI, backup safety and contractive MPC are existing methods.

upstream.reuse: Unmodified MPPI sampling/importance-weighted optimization and SpecificActionSampler. Application dynamics project every raw control onto the original80 actions BEFORE original smoothing.

difference_to_test: Finite progress obligation, not only safety or lower rolling objective: d(predicted robot at original deadline)<=activation distance-0.5m; deadline is not reset by replanning; retain revalidated prior plan if proposals cannot fulfill it. No formal safety guarantee under approximate human prediction; no claim basic deadline/backup is novel.

shared.humans: same currently observable full human set; no goals/future tape read by controller

planner.specific_plans: 80 constant original actions and80 actions held4 steps then current goal-direction fastest action
planner.objective: Negative discounted ORIGINAL native reward using legal CV human extrapolation; same hard predicted0.2m clearance requirement for all planner arms
planner.randomness: indexed seed=812121+scene*100000+case*300+step; same budget and random field in planner arms; different physical states remain divergent

trigger: 8 executed steps with net goal progress<0.2m; same trigger for low-commit8/mpc/hold8/deadline; prior commit8 retained as separate baseline. No trigger at goal.

interventions.mpc: 16-step rolling planning, execute1; intervention lasts16 decisions
interventions.hold8: Same plan search, execute8-step prefix while revalidating against current legal observations and native safe mask; replan on invalidation
interventions.deadline: Same16-step search, plus original deadline/certificate; retain prior feasible tail when no better certified replacement; cancel to nominal if no certified plan survives

development.note: Already used development cases. Reuse validated nominal/commit8 records, not fresh evidence.

confirmation.conditional: Only after development gate; freeze all code/parameters; compare nominal and strongest development simple and deadline. New cases not previously run.

go: deadline>=nominal+2 successes AND >=every simple+2 successes; no extra collision or independent contact versus any baseline; both-success navigation time<=1.10*strongest simple; changes executed choices; average decision latency<250ms. Otherwise KILL with preserved evidence, no threshold/budget rescue.
confirmation_pass: Paired success improvement over strongest simple with case-cluster bootstrap lower bound>0; no collision/contact regression; time nonregression; credible meaningful prior-method difference still required. An empirical gate alone is NOT paper PASS.
controls: Project/smooth contract and first predicted clearance equality, deterministic repeat, native-mask enforcement, fixed deadline not renewed, no future tape passed to controller, source and weight hashes, smoke6 scenes case301 twice. Any engineering failure stops outcomes until fixed and logged.
resources: Local3060 GRU inference, CPU MPPI; no4090; no training; original project unchanged.
